title: Three-dimensional colocalization analysis in immunostained sections of human pancreas
protocol: Create Volocity libraries from raw data files.
Drag raw data file(s) into pre-created library(s) to import calibrated images.
Select a raw image from the library and switch to the “Measurements” view by clicking the “Measurements” tab.
Build the analysis algorithm sequence under the “Measurements” view from the list of existing protocols.
Drag the appropriate protocols from the list of protocols and stack them in the specified sequence.
Select the appropriate channel for the marker to be analyzed.
Set the threshold to 3x standard deviations (SD).
Display the threshold popup window by clicking the cog icon.
Change “Threshold using” to “SD” and set the “Lower Limit” value to 3.
Click “Update Feedback” under the “Measurement” tab or select “Automatically Update Feedback”.
The results of the analysis are displayed automatically, with found objects highlighted.
Switch to the “Colocalization” view by clicking the “Colocalization” tab.
Select the appropriate channels for analysis (only 2 channels can be selected at any given time).
Use the same threshold values as in Step 4 (i.e., 3x SD) to set the minimum intensity value for each channel.
